::: {#sol-ticket-price-cases}

In `ticket-price`, Racket reaches the second test only when the first test is false,
so the condition for the second case is $5 \le a < 18$ rather than $a < 18$:

$$
p(a) =
\begin{cases}
0 & \text{if } a < 5, \\
8 & \text{if } 5 \le a < 18, \\
12 & \text{if } a \ge 18.
\end{cases}
$$

The [function](#def-function) $p$ gives the values that Racket returns in @sol-ticket-price:
$p(4) = 0$, $p(5) = 8$, $p(17) = 8$, and $p(70) = 12$.

:::
